Blocks.Text: This table shows all valid industry codes. If you use an industry code other than one that appears here, you will receive no results. The group is not used for the API call but is included here if you want to use these on an interface. You might want to have two drop downs with the first selecting a group and the second selecting the specific industry within that group.
We are migrating to Industry V2 codes and they will be available from April 2022.
